annotations.title: Rank check for up to 10 keywords (Google)

description: Where one domain ranks on live Google for up to 10 keywords in one country: best position, ranking URL and the top 3 domains for each keyword, plus SERP features. Same data and price as google_serp, billed per 10 results of depth for each keyword that returns results.

country.description: 2-letter country code (US, GB, DE...) or English name. Default US.

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, es, de. Default en.

target_domain.description: Domain to find, e.g. example.com (subdomains count).

name: rank_check
